The checkout screen is built at `src/screens/Screen.tsx` and `src/screens/Screen.module.css`.

Note: `@strata/react` isn't actually present in `node_modules` in this folder (no install found), and I have no way to run commands to install or inspect it. Rather than guess at an unverifiable component API and risk broken imports, I built the screen with plain semantic HTML/CSS Modules, styled using the Strata design tokens (CSS custom properties) referenced in `app.css`, with safe fallback values so it renders correctly whether or not the exact token names match. All layout uses logical CSS properties (`inline-start/end`, `text-align: start/end`, etc.) for correct RTL rendering in Arabic.

What it includes:
- Delivery address card with a "Change" link that reveals a radio-choice list of two mock addresses to switch between.
- Delivery slot picker with 3 selectable time windows.
- Item list (5 mock grocery items) each with a +/− quantity stepper (clamped 1–9).
- Promo code field (try mock code `FRESH10` for 10% off, capped at $15) with apply/remove and an invalid-code error state.
- Price breakdown: subtotal, delivery (free over $50), discount (shown only when applied), and total.
- "Place order" button showing the live total, which shows a confirmation message when clicked.

I couldn't run or visually verify the app since no Bash tool is available in this session — worth a quick dev-server check before shipping.
